title: kube-agents chart values
description: Every key values.yaml declares, closed at each level the templates read, so a misspelt or mistyped key fails `helm lint`, `helm template`, `helm install` and `helm upgrade` before anything renders. Left open, with no property list, because the templates pass them through or hand them to something else that validates them: platformAgent.annotations, platformAgent.networkPolicy, platformAgent.credentials.data, platformAgent.harness.tuning.{default,platform,cluster}, every resources block, both serviceAccountAnnotations maps, the operator.extraEnv and platformAgent.deployment.env items, the litellm.redaction.rules items, litellm.redaction.ip.action, and the global.imagePullSecrets items (a Secret name or {name: ...}; the chart's helper decides). values.yaml documents what each key does.

serviceUrl.description: Ignored. Accepted so existing values files still validate; the PlatformAgent CRD has no serviceUrl field, and the adapter takes the service URL from each inbound activity.

applyTuning.description: Merge the plugin's execution limits into platformAgent.harness.tuning. false keeps the install's own tuning.
